summary.caption: Wide cinematic environmental concept art shown as one continuous above-and-below cross-section, a tranquil floating garden city in warm daylight above the waterline and a vast mysterious submerged civilisation below, seamless vertical connection, luminous colour, atmospheric scale and detailed worldbuilding.

items.label: object
items.caption: Upper half: an airy floating garden city of white stone terraces, waterfalls, flowering trees and tiny sail craft beneath a golden sunrise, seen across a perfectly calm waterline.

items.label: object
items.caption: Lower half: an immense submerged civilisation of glowing turquoise towers, schools of fish, deep blue shafts of light and ancient structures descending into darkness directly beneath the city above.

items.label: character
items.caption: A lone free diver crossing the central waterline, body vertical and clearly silhouetted, reaching from the sunlit surface toward the glowing city below.

items.label: text
items.caption: Elegant slim white serif title in the upper-left sky.

items.label: text
items.caption: Elegant slim luminous cyan serif title in the lower-right depths.
